scope_reasoning: The current CLI builds the frozen three-field goal.start payload and S1 already permits null session/revision/epoch for a project-level Goal. The missing behavior is validation and adoption of the real host Goal result, then bounded following of its original Task and Run.

adoptV2Snapshot is in cli_v2.go; verbSteps and newV2Context are in cli_verbs.go; runCLIVerb, cliFlow.call, followCLIExecution and saveCLIContext are in cli_stream.go. The proposed fourth path hosts focused source-current tests. No domain, schema, migration, runtime or shared route path is needed for this CLI-only slice.

Frozen StartGoalResult requires Goal id, canonical positive Goal revision, enumerated Goal status and a SessionSnapshot. The Goal source candidate commit 841de8db021f197aa7b058a7f75cbb5c7096ce13 emits those fields from a real mapped session, with null top-level session_id only for project-level creation; it is not yet a reviewed or integrated host claim at this scope decision.

The S1 follower already binds a unique Goal Task and eventual Run, observes durable pages and canonical settlement, and returns unresolved when Task identity, reporting or cancellation proof is missing. Reusing it is within the four listed CLI paths.
required_implementation_checks: Validate the complete typed Goal result before mutating persistent CLI context. In particular, result.goal_status must equal nested snapshot.goal_status as well as the frozen enum; result.goal_id must equal snapshot.goal_id; both project and explicit session identity must match. A result with no real non-null snapshot identity is rejected.

v2CallTransport currently calls adoptV2Snapshot on a temporary attempt and cliFlow.call later adopts the shared context. The Goal-specific validation must gate the shared-context adoption and saved config; a malformed COMPLETED result cannot establish a session or retain an old writer epoch.

For a newly adopted Session, use snapshot.revision for writer CAS and Goal result.goal_revision only as canonical Goal metadata. Adopt writer.epoch only when snapshot.writer.client_id is this CLI client; an old epoch cannot carry into the new Session.

For an existing Session, read session.get first, capture the pre-admission event cursor and current writer CAS, then issue exactly one original goal.start envelope. Pending ACKNOWLEDGED/IN_PROGRESS replay must keep that envelope byte-identical.

An explicitly requested draft may report Goal establishment only when Goal and snapshot both say DRAFT, without execution polling or independent acceptance. A non-draft DRAFT or BLOCKED admission cannot exit zero as completed execution.

Set the original goal.start admission command identity and preserve signal intent before a Run exists. Interrupt before first write prevents the write; after dispatch, only the original Goal Task and Run may be followed or cancelled. Exit 130 requires host-confirmed cancellation.

A non-draft Goal may exit zero only after the S1 canonical Run/report/artifact/event settlement gates. No Goal method COMPLETED response, one-page event read, or accepted Goal status alone substitutes for that proof.

Keep JSONL stdout and existing context-resume behavior. Test goal, go and interactive /goal; cover no-session adoption, existing-session CAS, differing Goal/Session revisions, draft, pending replay, blocked/failed/incomplete/cancelled outcomes, malformed identities and stale epoch. Retain S1 regression evidence separately.
not_granted: Source edits before root registers the four exact paths, or edits to any fifth production path.
Host Goal source approval, independent review, LIVE qualification, provider calls, A04 or parent acceptance.
Multi-Task scheduling, synthetic Goal/session creation, independent business acceptance, new queue controls, or permission bypass.
